tips.discardTakeDirectPrimary: You can add it to your hand immediately without breaking an existing slot first.
tips.discardTakeDirectSecondary: If the net change is small, compare it with the next face-up discard before committing long-term.
tips.discardSwapSecondary: If you are already trying to lock this build, this face-up card is worth priority now.
tips.discardNoGainPrimary: Against your current hand, it does not produce a higher total yet.
tips.discardNoGainSecondary: Keep watching the next draw or the next face-up discard first.
tips.handDropPrimary: This card is currently dragging your total down, so it is a valid early discard candidate.
tips.handDropSecondary: If the next face-up discard also strengthens your active suit line, that discard slot becomes even more valuable.
tips.handKeepPrimary: This card is genuinely holding your total up right now.
tips.handKeepSecondary: Unless you need the slot for a much larger combo, do not treat it as your first discard.
tips.handNeutralPrimary: Right now this card is mostly occupying space without a clear net gain.
tips.handNeutralSecondary: Wait for the next draw or face-up discard to see whether it can join a real scoring line.
tips.reviewPrimary: Compare it with the final standings, face-up discard pile, and full hand to confirm which scoring line it really supported.
tips.reviewSecondary: During endgame review, this panel is better used as a structure checkpoint than as a next-step hint.

focus.hiddenDescription: The current focus is not in a public zone, so this panel does not reveal its name, text, or estimate. Once it becomes public or the match reaches endgame review, the real card will appear here.
focus.hiddenTipPrimary: Keep watching the open discard pile, the active turn marker, and changes to your own hand.
focus.hiddenTipSecondary: As soon as the current focus becomes public, this panel switches back to the real card automatically.
focus.reviewDescription: Endgame review: this card has already been scored against the final table. It is now more useful to compare it with the open discard pile, final standings, and your full hand to understand its real contribution.
focus.reviewTipPrimary: Compare this card against the final standings, open discard pile, and full hand to verify its actual bonus or penalty impact.
focus.reviewTipSecondary: No next-step decision hint is shown during endgame review; this panel is now review-only.
